units.rawText: Neural cloud data quick organization complete. 2692 errors detected.

spans.text: Neural cloud data quick organization complete. 2692 errors detected.

units.rawText: Ah, that's my neural cloud processing system... Have things gotten so bad?
units.displayText: Ah, that's my neural cloud processing system... Have things gotten so bad?

spans.text: Ah, that's my neural cloud processing system... Have things gotten so bad?

units.rawText: I guess I can't handle all this by myself.
units.displayText: I guess I can't handle all this by myself.

spans.text: I guess I can't handle all this by myself.

units.rawText: Keep all the errors this time. I want to go back and take a look at that "aquarium"...
units.displayText: Keep all the errors this time. I want to go back and take a look at that "aquarium"...

spans.text: Keep all the errors this time. I want to go back and take a look at that "aquarium"...

units.rawText: I want to see what other memories I can find in this world I've been running from.
units.displayText: I want to see what other memories I can find in this world I've been running from.

spans.text: I want to see what other memories I can find in this world I've been running from.

units.rawText: Is this... the aquarium?
units.displayText: Is this... the aquarium?

spans.text: Is this... the aquarium?

units.rawText: Ngh... Who's that?
units.displayText: Ngh... Who's that?

spans.text: Ngh... Who's that?

units.rawText: It's us, your capable employees. We're here to help you tidy up this place.
units.displayText: It's us, your capable employees. We're here to help you tidy up this place.

spans.text: It's us, your capable employees. We're here to help you tidy up this place.

units.rawText: That said, isn't this an aquarium? You told us there wasn't one before...
units.displayText: That said, isn't this an aquarium? You told us there wasn't one before...

spans.text: That said, isn't this an aquarium? You told us there wasn't one before...

units.rawText: ...Uwah, did I accidentally encourage you to break the rules? Is that okay?
units.displayText: ...Uwah, did I accidentally encourage you to break the rules? Is that okay?

spans.text: ...Uwah, did I accidentally encourage you to break the rules? Is that okay?

units.rawText: (Groans) My head's still a little fuzzy...
units.displayText: (Groans) My head's still a little fuzzy...

spans.text: (Groans) My head's still a little fuzzy...

units.rawText: We were calling out to you just now, but you didn't respond. It seems you crashed again. However, it's good to see you wake up safely again.
units.displayText: We were calling out to you just now, but you didn't respond. It seems you crashed again. However, it's good to see you wake up safely again.

spans.text: We were calling out to you just now, but you didn't respond. It seems you crashed again. However, it's good to see you wake up safely again.

units.rawText: I... Did I worry you just now?
units.displayText: I... Did I worry you just now?

spans.text: I... Did I worry you just now?

units.rawText: It's alright, take your time. Why don't you gather your thoughts? It's okay if you can't recall them.
units.displayText: It's alright, take your time. Why don't you gather your thoughts? It's okay if you can't recall them.

spans.text: It's alright, take your time. Why don't you gather your thoughts? It's okay if you can't recall them.

units.rawText: Taisch is silent for a while. She then shakes her head, and her glowing bunny ears sway in the aquarium's light as well.
units.displayText: Taisch is silent for a while. She then shakes her head, and her glowing bunny ears sway in the aquarium's light as well.

spans.text: Taisch is silent for a while. She then shakes her head, and her glowing bunny ears sway in the aquarium's light as well.

units.rawText: She looks at the gigantic, empty tank and hugs Miss Bunny tightly. Arctic Fox comes to a halt under her feet and nuzzles her calf.
units.displayText: She looks at the gigantic, empty tank and hugs Miss Bunny tightly. Arctic Fox comes to a halt under her feet and nuzzles her calf.

spans.text: She looks at the gigantic, empty tank and hugs Miss Bunny tightly. Arctic Fox comes to a halt under her feet and nuzzles her calf.

units.rawText: So this was what you were trying to tell me all along. Thank you, Arctic Fox. It must have been hard for you.
units.displayText: So this was what you were trying to tell me all along. Thank you, Arctic Fox. It must have been hard for you.

spans.text: So this was what you were trying to tell me all along. Thank you, Arctic Fox. It must have been hard for you.

units.rawText:
Awoo—
(You're the one who's been having a hard time, Taisch.)
units.displayText:
Awoo—
(You're the one who's been having a hard time, Taisch.)

spans.text:
Awoo—
(You're the one who's been having a hard time, Taisch.)

units.rawText: My neural cloud hasn't been this packed in a long time... It's a little hard to handle, so I'm getting sleepy again.
units.displayText: My neural cloud hasn't been this packed in a long time... It's a little hard to handle, so I'm getting sleepy again.

spans.text: My neural cloud hasn't been this packed in a long time... It's a little hard to handle, so I'm getting sleepy again.

units.rawText: You guys must have worked really hard to help me keep these memories and problems around. Thank you.
units.displayText: You guys must have worked really hard to help me keep these memories and problems around. Thank you.

(How much do you remember?)

Gaoooo—
(How much do you remember?)

, I guess.
